page.overview:
What is Desert Region?

The Desert Region is a region located in Grymoire in World of Final Fantasy. It is reached by traversing through The Windswept Mire. It is first visited in Chapter 13, "Castle in the Desert" and is the starting location of Chapter 16, "Clash on Big Bridge".

Located in the south of the region. It is the first part of the region to be visited.

Located in the south southwest of the region. This is the only place accessible when the area is first visited.

Hidden under the sand when the area is first visited.
